crossRefs.note: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
The king stood by the pillar, and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments…
The king stood in his place, and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, and…
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk…
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing…
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk…
You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.
to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that…
Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from…
But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

translations.web: You shall walk after Yahweh your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.
translations.bsb: You are to follow the LORD your God and fear Him. Keep His commandments and listen to His voice; serve Him and hold fast to Him.
translations.kjv: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave
translations.asv: Ye shall walk after Jehovah your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
